label: Actual action-changing acquisition…: ReviewInfluence says some change to the earlier review input…
definition: ReviewInfluence says some change to the earlier review input changes the selected actual action while external=false, reason=true and imposed=false stay fixed, compared with review=false. ExternalInfluence varies only external setting with review=false and the same reason/constraint. These are explicit action-sensitivity predicates under stipulated interventions, not flags for ownership, freedom, blame or actual physical ability under identical past and laws. Earlier acquisition dependence can be masked by a downstream imposed override.
